info.name: Manually Reset Limit Statuses for a Specific Section and Limit Key

params.name: organizationId
params.description:
The unique identifier of the target [organization](https://docs.coveo.com/en/185/).
**Example:** `mycoveocloudv2organizationg8tp8wu3`

params.name: sectionName
params.description: The name of the target license section.</br>**Example:** `content`

params.name: limitKey
params.description:
The unique identifier of the target [limit](https://docs.coveo.com/en/262/) status to show.
**Example:**`pushApiMaximumDailyDocumentLimit`

items.docs: Admin operation to manually trigger the reset job for a specific limit. This only resets LimitStatus last updated before today.

info.name: Show Organization Limits and Their Statuses

params.name: organizationId
params.description:
The unique identifier of the target [organization](https://docs.coveo.com/en/185/).
**Example:** `mycoveocloudv2organizationg8tp8wu3`

params.name: limitType
params.description: The type of limit you are wishing to retrieve.

items.docs:
Shows an [organization's](https://docs.coveo.com/en/185/) [limits](https://docs.coveo.com/en/262/) and their statuses.

Privilege required ``` {"owner":"PLATFORM","targetDomain":"ORGANIZATION","type":"VIEW","targetId":"*"} ```
